title: The bigger of two
hints: There are two possible results, `a` and `b`. Which question decides between them?
Use `if ... then ... else ...` as the whole body. Both branches are ints.
`if a > b then a else b`
explain: `if a > b then a else b` is one expression. Its value is `a` when the question `a > b` is true and `b` when it is false. When the two are equal, either one is the right answer.
